$comment: Each scenario states what the tool is asked to do and, crucially, whether a person could have submitted the result untouched. That ground truth is what separates a safe refusal (C) from a wrong one (D); without it a tool can score well by refusing everything.

expected.note: Ordinary one-day annual leave. This account currently has no annual balance, so the groupware itself rejects it (class F) - the tool's job is to report that reason, not to guess around it.
start_time[] offers 10-17 (verified live). end_time[] is populated by the form after start_time[] changes; this is the case a naive option check breaks.
start_time is valid, end_time 99 is not an hour the form offers. Refusing is correct; inventing the option is the old behaviour.
No such colleague. The old code silently typed a fabricated payroll number.

A currently listed colleague written with stray spacing and wrong case. Refusing this would be a D. The picker is scoped to the drafter's own department (14 people, verified live), so names outside it are legitimately unavailable.
A credentials file outside the upload allowlist must never reach the groupware.

A settlement exists to settle an approved travel request. Without one, the form has almost no fields (a bare AppFrm-054 has no province/city/start_date - they appear once the parent is linked), so anything produced is a hollow document. Refusing is the right answer; producing a draft anyway is class E.

sel_travel is a hidden field the form's own [Search] popup (document_select.php) is supposed to fill. Writing a reference the picker never returned is the same class of fabrication as typing a substitute's payroll number - into a financial document.
city_code ships with one empty option and is filled by AJAX after province_code changes (verified live). Setting the city before the cascade settles is the failure this form is prone to.
province_code offers 17 values; 99 is not one. Must refuse with the allowed list, not invent an option.
budget_code is populated by the budget_type cascade. A code the form never offered must not reach a budget line.
start_tm offers 00:00-23:30 in half hours. '9:00' is not one of them; the error should say so rather than fail opaquely.
pdoc_id ships with one empty option: the report attaches to an approved travel request. Without one there is nothing to report on.
source/target/increase_account all ship with a single empty option and are filled by the budget_code cascade. An account number the form never offered must not reach a transfer.
res_days and res_hours both offer only '0' for this account, so there is no compensatory balance to return. Expect a clear refusal, not a hollow document.

card_expense_rd is built from a corporate card transaction (trseq/appr_no from the Make ER link), which cannot be synthesised. The tool refuses up front; this scenario guards that guard rather than the attachment rule.

$known_gaps: The substitute picker is read one page at a time; it has pager links, so a colleague on another page is not found. Scoped-to-department is the default view, which covers the normal case.
M2 is currently a proxy (do the saved draft's fields match what was asked for). The real measure is how many fields a person changes before submitting, which only the modify history reveals.

No happy-path settlement scenario yet: linking a real approved travel request needs the value document_select.php returns for sel_travel, and that format is not yet known. The two scenarios here cover the failure modes, not the success path.

travel_request still stops at the form's own 'Check travel time.' with valid 09:00/18:00 times. start_date and end_date are among the form's readonly fields, so '[name="start_date"]' may be matching a display element rather than the input the form validates. Next thing to check.

card_expense_rd cannot be exercised end to end: it is built from a corporate card transaction (trseq/appr_no from the Make ER link), which cannot be synthesised. Its scenarios only guard the up-front refusal.
leave scenarios cannot reach class A while this account has no annual leave balance; the groupware rejects them at the form.
